phase_1.title: Phase 1 · SIG SG 550 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.56×45mm NATO (GP 90) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 430 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 430 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 528 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 905 m/s (1680 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the SIG SG 550 staged for its 700 RPM cyclic (Semi / 3-Rd Burst / Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪：1986 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 被公认为「瑞士制表级 AK」的 SIG SG 550（瑞士军方编号 Stgw 90）将复进簧同轴套装于前端长行程活塞杆之上，配合 2 档防冻导气阀、内藏式折叠两脚架、可互锁半透明弹匣与极高公差冲压机匣，缔造了步兵步枪的精度传奇。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：SIG SG 550 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1986 年问世的 瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪 由瑞士瑞士工业公司（SIG / SAN Swiss Arms）主导研制，定位为经典的精密突击步枪。瑞士公民兵役传统要求士兵退伍后保留 Stgw 90 参加年度 300 米实弹射击考核，促使 SIG 将 SG 550 打造成全球最精准的大规模列装军用突击步枪之一。
被公认为「瑞士制表级 AK」的 SIG SG 550（瑞士军方编号 Stgw 90）将复进簧同轴套装于前端长行程活塞杆之上，配合 2 档防冻导气阀、内藏式折叠两脚架、可互锁半透明弹匣与极高公差冲压机匣，缔造了步兵步枪的精度传奇。 整件装备总长 998 mm（展开）/ 772 mm（折叠托）、空重 4.1 kg，成为同期突击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1986 年，瑞士瑞士工业公司（SIG / SAN Swiss Arms）推出了划时代的瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪。瑞士公民兵役传统要求士兵退伍后保留 Stgw 90 参加年度 300 米实弹射击考核，促使 SIG 将 SG 550 打造成全球最精准的大规模列装军用突击步枪之一。 它的核心设计聚焦于复进簧同轴环绕活塞杆前移，腾出机匣尾部空间实现无缝右侧折叠镂空枪托，奠定了其在突击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「瑞士精工长行程导气活塞（复进簧绕活塞杆）· 双突笋回转枪机」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用橄榄绿军规防腐涂层钢与增强聚合物精加工而成。2 档可调导气阀与冷锻 528 mm 枪管可在阿尔卑斯零下 30°C 严寒下稳定击发，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪 采用瑞士精工长行程导气活塞（复进簧绕活塞杆）· 双突笋回转枪机。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助橄榄绿军规防腐涂层钢与增强聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了2 档可调导气阀与冷锻 528 mm 枪管可在阿尔卑斯零下 30°C 严寒下稳定击发。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.56×45mm NATO (GP 90) 弹药规格与 528 mm 精密冷锻枪管（6 条右旋膛线 · 254 mm / 1:10 缠距），最高工作膛压约 430 MPa，可赋予弹头 905 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,680 J 动能，有效作用距离达 400 米。
内膛技术特点方面，1:10 缠距专调瑞士 63 gr GP 90 竞赛级军用弹，300 米精度媲美靶场竞赛枪。同时，标志性半透明聚合物弹匣带侧置卡榫，无需额外夹具即可多匣并联，令其在 700 发/分（单发 / 3 发点射 / 全自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 528 毫米身管与 5.56×45mm NATO (GP 90) 口径，瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪 实现了每秒 905 米的初速与 400 米有效射程。1:10 缠距专调瑞士 63 gr GP 90 竞赛级军用弹，300 米精度媲美靶场竞赛枪，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 40 mm 膛轴设计，瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 5.2 N·s 水平。护木槽内齐平收纳轻型两脚架，配有 100–400 米精密鼓形觇孔照门与冬季大扳机护圈。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-47）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，护木槽内齐平收纳轻型两脚架，配有 100–400 米精密鼓形觇孔照门与冬季大扳机护圈。欢迎在 BAY-47 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 瑞士 SIG SG 550（Stgw 90）精密突击步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the SIG SG 550
paragraphs: Introduced in 1986 by SIG Arms / SAN Swiss Arms in Switzerland, the SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90) emerged as a defining Precision Assault Rifle. Driven by Switzerland’s 300-meter mandatory citizen-soldier marksmanship culture, the SG 550 was engineered to outshoot virtually every other mass-issued service assault rifle.

Revered as the “Swiss watchmaker’s AK,” the SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90) wraps its recoil spring coaxially around the front long-stroke piston rod, marrying AK-grade alpine reliability with match-grade 300 m precision. Measuring 998 mm (Extended) / 772 mm (Folded) at an unloaded weight of 4.1 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1986, SIG Arms / SAN Swiss Arms of Switzerland introduced the SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90). Driven by Switzerland’s 300-meter mandatory citizen-soldier marksmanship culture, the SG 550 was engineered to outshoot virtually every other mass-issued service assault rifle. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Coaxial recoil spring on the piston rod frees the rear receiver for a clean side-folding stock — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90) sits its Swiss-Precision Long-Stroke Piston (Coaxial Recoil Spring) · Dual-Lug Rotating Bolt. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 430 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in OD-green protective-coated steel and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 2-position gas valve and 528 mm hammer-forged barrel maintain reliability in alpine extremes, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90) relies on Swiss-Precision Long-Stroke Piston (Coaxial Recoil Spring) · Dual-Lug Rotating Bolt. During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from OD-green protective-coated steel and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 2-position gas valve and 528 mm hammer-forged barrel maintain reliability in alpine extremes.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.56×45mm NATO (GP 90) with 528 mm Cold Hammer-Forged Barrel (6-Groove RH · 1:10" Twist for GP 90), the SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90) develops 905 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,680 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 400 meters.

Internally, 1:10" rifling tailored for Swiss 63 gr GP 90 ammunition delivers match-grade 300 m groupings. Combined with its 700 RPM cyclic (Semi / 3-Rd Burst / Auto) tempo, Translucent magazines feature molded interlocking studs for tool-free magazine coupling, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.56×45mm NATO (GP 90) through its 528 millimeter bore, the SIG SG 550 (Stgw 90) achieves 905 meters per second and 400 meters of effective reach. 1:10" rifling tailored for Swiss 63 gr GP 90 ammunition delivers match-grade 300 m groupings.

paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with a 40 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 5.2 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Flush-folding integrated bipod, 100–400 m rotary diopter sight, and folding winter trigger guard.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-47), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
